tagline.value: 400 million people were waiting for the truth.
A comedy from the heart that goes for the throat.
A stiff drink. A little mascara. A lot of nerve. Who said they couldn't bring down the Soviet empire.
A story of love, lava and burning desire.
After life there is more. The end is just the beginning.
At odds in life... in love on-line.
At the edge of the world, his journey begins.
Based on the extraordinary true story of one man's fight for freedom
Break The Codes
Can two friends sleep together and still love each other in the morning?
Come as you are
Don't Breathe. Don't Look Back.
Everything is connected
Everything that has a beginning has an end
Evil has its winning ways
First loves last. Forever.
For some, it's the last real taste of innocence, and the first real taste of life. But for everyone, it's the time that memories are made of.
Free your mind
Freedom! Forever!
He didn't want law. He wanted justice.
Houston, we have a problem.
I feel the need, the need for speed.
If he's crazy, what does that make you?

It's a hell of a thing, killing a man

title.value: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest

examples.question: Find the top 5 movies with the most votes.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.votes IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.votes ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: List all movies with a 'Pretty funny at times' review summary.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.summary = 'Pretty funny at times' RETURN m.title

examples.question: List the movies with more than 100 votes.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.votes > 100 RETURN m.title

examples.question: Who are the top 3 producers by the number of movies with different taglines?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline IS NOT NULL WITH p, count(DISTINCT m.tagline) AS distinctTaglines ORDER BY distinctTaglines DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name, distinctTaglines

examples.question: Which people have directed movies with a budget higher than $100 million?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m

examples.question: What are the roles of Keanu Reeves in 'The Matrix'?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.name = 'Keanu Reeves' AND m.title = 'The Matrix' RETURN r.roles AS roles

examples.question: List all people who have written and directed the same movie.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie) WHERE (p)-[:DIRECTED]->(m) RETURN DISTINCT p.name

examples.question: Which top 5 people have directed movies with more than 200 votes?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.votes > 200 WITH p, count(m) AS num_movies ORDER BY num_movies DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN p.name AS director, num_movies

examples.question: List the names of people who acted in movies directed by Nancy Meyers.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Nancy Meyers'})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) MATCH (a:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m) RETURN DISTINCT a.name

examples.question: What are the top 3 highest rated reviews and which movies they are associated with?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS movie, r.rating AS rating, r.summary AS review ORDER BY r.rating DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Which movies have been both written and directed by the same person and what are their titles?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) MATCH (p)-[:WROTE]->(m) RETURN m.title AS movie_title

examples.question: List the movies with exactly 3 roles in the ACTED_IN relationship.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) WHERE size(r.roles) = 3 RETURN m.title

examples.question: What are the first 3 movies with a released year of 2008?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released = 2008 RETURN m.title, m.released ORDER BY m.title LIMIT 3

examples.question: What is the average number of words in the review summaries of movies with a rating above 95?
examples.cypher: MATCH (:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating > 95 WITH size(split(r.summary, " ")) AS words RETURN avg(words) AS average_word_count

examples.question: Which people follow Keanu Reeves and have also acted in a movie with him?
examples.cypher: MATCH (follower:Person)-[:FOLLOWS]->(keanu:Person {name: "Keanu Reeves"}) WHERE exists {     (follower)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(keanu) } RETURN follower

examples.question: Show top 3 persons who directed, produced, and acted in the same movie.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:PRODUCED]-(p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m) RETURN p.name, collect(m.title) AS movies ORDER BY size(movies) DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Who are the first three people who have directed and reviewed the same movie?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:REVIEWED]-(p) RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

examples.question: Find all movies with a rating above 90.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.rating > 90 RETURN m.title, r.rating

examples.question: Which year saw the release of the most movies?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH m.released AS releaseYear, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC RETURN releaseYear, movieCount LIMIT 1

examples.question: List all movies that have a 'Fun, but a little far fetched' review summary.

literals: Fun, but a little far fetched

examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.summary = 'Fun, but a little far fetched' RETURN m.title

examples.question: Which people have reviewed a movie with the words "Robin Williams" in the summary?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.summary CONTAINS 'Robin Williams' RETURN DISTINCT p.name

examples.question: List 3 actors who also have roles as producers.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie), (p)-[:PRODUCED]->(:Movie) RETURN DISTINCT p.name LIMIT 3

examples.question: Who are the first 3 actors in the movie titled 'Speed Racer'?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie {title: 'Speed Racer'}) RETURN p.name, r.roles LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the first 3 movies that have been produced and directed by the same person.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:PRODUCED]-(p) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle LIMIT 3

examples.question: Which movies have the word "coolest" in their review summary?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.summary CONTAINS 'coolest' RETURN DISTINCT m.title

examples.question: Who are the top 3 producers of movies with a tagline including 'Speed'?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'Speed' RETURN p.name, count(m) AS movies_produced ORDER BY movies_produced DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the first 3 movies released in the 21st century that Laurence Fishburne produced.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Laurence Fishburne"})-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released >= 2001 RETURN m ORDER BY m.released ASC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Which person has the highest average rating for movies they wrote?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WITH p, avg(r.rating) AS average_rating RETURN p.name, average_rating ORDER BY average_rating DESC LIMIT 1

examples.question: Who has the most movies with a 'Silly, but fun' review summary?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:REVIEWED {summary: 'Silly, but fun'}]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN p.name AS personName, movieCount

examples.question: What are the 3 most common taglines found in the movies?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline IS NOT NULL RETURN m.tagline AS Tagline, count(m) AS Frequency ORDER BY Frequency DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Who has produced movies but never acted in any?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE exists{ (p)-[:PRODUCED]->(:Movie) }   AND NOT exists{ (p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie) } RETURN p.name

examples.question: Which persons have acted in and directed the same movie?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(p) RETURN p.name AS personName, m.title AS movieTitle

examples.question: Which persons have directed the most movies with a tagline containing 'world'?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'world' WITH p, COUNT(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN p.name AS director, movieCount

examples.question: Find the top 5 movies with the most votes.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.votes IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: Find all people born in 1949 who have directed a movie.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.born = 1949 AND exists{ (p)-[:DIRECTED]->(:Movie) } RETURN p

examples.question: Find all movies that have been produced by persons born after 1960 limited to top 5.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born > 1960 RETURN m LIMIT 5

examples.question: List all movies with more than 2000 votes.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.votes > 2000 RETURN m.title, m.votes

examples.question: Who are the top 3 actors with the most diverse roles?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, r.roles AS roles UNWIND roles AS role WITH p, COUNT(DISTINCT role) AS uniqueRolesCount RETURN p.name AS actor, uniqueRolesCount ORDER BY uniqueRolesCount DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the top 5 movies with the most roles listed in ACTED_IN relationship.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) RETURN m.title AS movie, size(r.roles) AS roleCount ORDER BY roleCount DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: Find the people who have followed someone with the same birth year.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p1:Person)-[:FOLLOWS]->(p2:Person) WHERE p1.born = p2.born RETURN p1, p2

examples.question: Who has reviewed 'Speed Racer' and what was their rating?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie {title: 'Speed Racer'}) RETURN p.name AS reviewer, r.rating AS rating

examples.question: List the first 3 movies that Keanu Reeves has acted in with their release years.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Keanu Reeves'})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS movie, m.released AS year ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the top 5 oldest movies in the database.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.released ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 5

examples.question: List the top 5 youngest people who have written a movie.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WROTE]->(:Movie) RETURN p.name, p.born ORDER BY p.born DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: Who are the top 3 actors by number of followers?
examples.cypher: MATCH (actor:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie) OPTIONAL MATCH (follower:Person)-[:FOLLOWS]->(actor) WITH actor, COUNT(follower) AS followerCount RETURN actor.name AS actorName, followerCount ORDER BY followerCount DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: What is the name of the person who directed 'The Matrix'?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie {title: 'The Matrix'}) RETURN p.name

examples.question: Which people have both acted in and reviewed the same movie?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[a:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p) RETURN p.name, m.title, a.roles, r.summary, r.rating

examples.question: What are the top 5 movies with the least votes and their release years?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS title, m.released AS release_year, m.votes AS votes ORDER BY m.votes ASC LIMIT 5

examples.question: What are the 3 newest relationships formed in the graph (any type)?
examples.cypher: MATCH ()-[r]-() RETURN r, type(r) ORDER BY id(r) DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: List top 3 movies released before 1980.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released < 1980 RETURN m ORDER BY m.released DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Name 3 people who have the most combined roles across all their ACTED_IN movies.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[a:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, sum(size(a.roles)) AS totalRoles ORDER BY totalRoles DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS PersonName, totalRoles

examples.question: Find the 3 oldest movies reviewed by someone born after 1970.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born > 1970 RETURN m ORDER BY m.released ASC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Who are the first three actors who acted in more than three movies with a tagline containing the word 'limit'?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'limit' WITH p, count(m) AS movies_count WHERE movies_count > 3 RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

examples.question: Who has produced, directed, and acted in the most movies?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE exists{(p)-[:PRODUCED]->(:Movie)} AND        exists{(p)-[:DIRECTED]->(:Movie)} AND        exists{(p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie)} WITH p, count{(p)-[:PRODUCED]->(:Movie)} AS producedCount,            count{(p)-[:DIRECTED]->(:Movie)} AS directedCount,            count{(p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie)} AS actedInCount RETURN p.name, producedCount, directedCount, actedInCount ORDER BY producedCount + directedCount + actedInCount DESC LIMIT 1

examples.question: Show the first 3 movies with the most complex role lists in the 'ACTED_IN' relationship.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:ACTED_IN]-(:Person) WITH m, size(r.roles) AS role_count ORDER BY role_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title AS movie_title, role_count

examples.question: List the roles of actors in the 3 movies with the highest number of actors involved.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) WITH m, count(p) AS actorCount ORDER BY actorCount DESC LIMIT 3 MATCH (m)<-[r:ACTED_IN]-(p) RETURN m.title AS movieTitle, p.name AS actorName, r.roles AS roles

examples.question: Who are the people who have reviewed the most movies?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(m) AS reviewCount ORDER BY reviewCount DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN p.name AS reviewerName, reviewCount

examples.question: List the movies directed by persons born after 1960.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born > 1960 RETURN m.title

examples.question: What are the roles of actors in the movie titled 'Speed Racer'?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie {title: 'Speed Racer'}) RETURN p.name, r.roles

examples.question: What are the top 3 least voted for movies in the database?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.votes ORDER BY m.votes LIMIT 3

examples.question: What are the top 3 movies with the most distinct actors in the ACTED_IN relationship?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) WITH m, count(DISTINCT p) AS actorCount ORDER BY actorCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title AS movieTitle, actorCount

examples.question: Who are the first 3 people to review a movie with a summary 'Pretty funny at times'?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.summary = 'Pretty funny at times' RETURN p.name ORDER BY r.rating DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: List 3 movies that have been reviewed with a summary mentioning 'funny'.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.summary CONTAINS 'funny' RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

examples.question: What is the average rating for movies with "The Matrix" in the title?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.title CONTAINS 'The Matrix' WITH m MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m) RETURN avg(r.rating)

examples.question: Find all movies where the director is also listed as an actor.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m) WHERE (p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m) RETURN DISTINCT m.title

examples.question: List the movies where Joel Silver has a production role.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Joel Silver"})-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.released AS ReleaseYear

examples.question: Which movie has the most roles in the 'ACTED_IN' relationship and what are those roles?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS Movie, r.roles AS Roles ORDER BY size(r.roles) DESC LIMIT 1

examples.question: Who reviewed the movie with the highest rating and what was the summary?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WITH m, r, p ORDER BY r.rating DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN p.name AS reviewer, r.summary AS review_summary

examples.question: Who are the top 3 reviewers by average rating given?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, avg(r.rating) AS avg_rating ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS reviewer, avg_rating

examples.question: Find all people who have both produced and directed movies.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(:Movie) WITH p MATCH (p)-[:PRODUCED]->(:Movie) RETURN DISTINCT p.name

examples.question: What is the average rating for movies with a tagline longer than 20 characters?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WHERE size(m.tagline) > 20 RETURN avg(r.rating) AS average_rating

examples.question: Find the movie with the highest number of votes that has the word "Welcome" in its tagline.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'Welcome' RETURN m.title, m.votes ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 1

examples.question: List the movies released between 1990 and 2000 with a rating higher than 80.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE m.released >= 1990 AND m.released <= 2000 AND r.rating > 80 RETURN DISTINCT m.title

examples.question: Which movies have been directed by persons born after 1970?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born > 1970 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.released AS ReleaseYear

examples.question: Find the movie with the lowest number of votes that has the word "times" in its review summary.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WHERE r.summary CONTAINS 'times' RETURN m.title AS movieTitle, m.votes AS movieVotes ORDER BY movieVotes LIMIT 1

examples.question: Who are the top 3 people born after 1960 who have directed a movie titled 'V for Vendetta'?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie {title: 'V for Vendetta'}) WHERE p.born > 1960 RETURN p.name, p.born ORDER BY p.born DESC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Which movies released between 2005 and 2010 have the tagline 'Speed has no limits'?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released >= 2005 AND m.released <= 2010   AND m.tagline = 'Speed has no limits' RETURN m.title

examples.question: Who has the most directed movies in the database?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, COUNT(m) AS directedMovies ORDER BY directedMovies DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN p.name AS director, directedMovies

examples.question: List all movies where the writer is also credited as a producer.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:WROTE]-(p:Person) WHERE (p)-[:PRODUCED]->(m) RETURN m.title

examples.question: Which persons have reviewed movies with a rating of 100?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating = 100 RETURN p.name

examples.question: List all movies produced by persons who have also directed a movie with the same title.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) MATCH (p)-[:DIRECTED]->(m2:Movie) WHERE m.title = m2.title RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, p.name AS ProducerDirector

examples.question: Who has the most roles in a single movie?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name AS person, m.title AS movie, size(r.roles) AS num_roles ORDER BY num_roles DESC LIMIT 1

examples.question: Name 3 persons who have reviewed the most movies released before 2000.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released < 2000 WITH p, count(r) AS reviews ORDER BY reviews DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS PersonName, reviews AS NumberOfReviews

examples.question: Which person produced movies directed by Lana Wachowski?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Lana Wachowski"})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) MATCH (producer:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m) RETURN DISTINCT producer.name

examples.question: Which movies have been produced by more than one person?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WITH m, count(p) AS producers_count WHERE producers_count > 1 RETURN m.title AS Movie, producers_count

examples.question: Show the top 3 movies with the lowest number of votes.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.votes ORDER BY m.votes ASC LIMIT 3

examples.question: Which persons born after 1980 have acted in, directed, or produced any movies?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.born > 1980 AND (   (p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie) OR   (p)-[:DIRECTED]->(:Movie) OR   (p)-[:PRODUCED]->(:Movie) ) RETURN p

examples.question: What are the names of the first 3 people who have produced, directed, and written the same movie?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE exists {   (p)-[:DIRECTED]->(m) } AND exists {   (p)-[:WROTE]->(m) } RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

examples.question: What is the title of the movie with the highest number of votes?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.votes ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 1

examples.question: What is the title of the movie with the oldest director?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title, p.born ORDER BY p.born ASC LIMIT 1

examples.question: Find the actors who have acted in movies with a release year that is a prime number.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE all(i IN range(2, toInteger(ceil(sqrt(m.released)))) WHERE m.released % i <> 0) RETURN DISTINCT p.name

examples.question: Who has reviewed the most movies with a rating above 90?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating > 90 WITH p, count(m) AS moviesReviewed ORDER BY moviesReviewed DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN p.name AS reviewer, moviesReviewed

examples.question: List all the movies where the director and writer are the same person.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(d:Person) MATCH (m)<-[:WROTE]-(w:Person) WHERE d = w RETURN m.title, d.name

examples.question: Which people have directed movies with the word "Give" in the title?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(p:Person) WHERE m.title CONTAINS 'Give' RETURN DISTINCT p.name

examples.question: Who are the actors who have acted in movies directed by someone born in the same decade as them?
examples.cypher: MATCH (director:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(movie:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(actor:Person) WHERE director.born / 10 = actor.born / 10 RETURN DISTINCT actor.name

examples.question: Who reviewed movies with a rating higher than 90?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating > 90 RETURN p.name

examples.question: What are the 3 oldest movies in the database?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.released ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

examples.question: Who are the top 5 actors by the number of movies they acted in?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, COUNT(m) AS movieCount RETURN p.name AS actor, movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: Who has directed the most movies released after 2000 and what are those movies?
examples.cypher: MATCH (director:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(movie:Movie) WHERE movie.released > 2000 WITH director, count(movie) AS movieCount, collect(movie.title) AS movies ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN director.name AS directorName, movies

examples.question: List the first 3 movies with a tagline containing the word 'journey'.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'journey' RETURN m LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the actors born after 1980 who have acted in more than one movie.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born > 1980 WITH p, count(m) AS numMovies WHERE numMovies > 1 RETURN p.name AS actor, numMovies

examples.question: List all the movies reviewed with the summary 'An amazing journey'.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:REVIEWED {summary: 'An amazing journey'}]-(:Person) RETURN m

examples.question: Which movies have been reviewed with a summary 'Fun, but a little far fetched' and what were their ratings?

literals: Fun, but a little far fetched

examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.summary = 'Fun, but a little far fetched' RETURN m.title, r.rating

examples.question: Which actors were born after 1970?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.born > 1970 AND exists{ (p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie) } RETURN p.name AS actor, p.born AS year_born

examples.question: List all movies where the same person has acted and produced.
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie), (p)-[:PRODUCED]->(m) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.released AS ReleaseYear

examples.question: Find the top 5 movies with the lowest ratings in REVIEWS.
examples.cypher: MATCH (:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS movie, AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating ORDER BY average_rating ASC LIMIT 5

examples.question: Who has produced and written the same movie?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie)<-[:WROTE]-(p) RETURN p.name AS person, m.title AS movie

examples.question: List the actors who have acted in movies directed by both Lilly Wachowski and Lana Wachowski.
examples.cypher: MATCH (lilly:Person {name: 'Lilly Wachowski'})-[:DIRECTED]->(lillyMovies:Movie) MATCH (lana:Person {name: 'Lana Wachowski'})-[:DIRECTED]->(lanaMovies:Movie) MATCH (lillyMovies)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(lillyActors:Person) MATCH (lanaMovies)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(lanaActors:Person) WITH lillyActors, lanaActors WHERE id(lillyActors) = id(lanaActors) RETURN DISTINCT lillyActors.name AS actorName

examples.question: Show the top 3 movies with the lowest number of votes.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.votes IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.votes ASC LIMIT 3

examples.question: List the top 5 movies that have not been reviewed.

examples.question: What are the top 3 movies with the most distinct taglines?

examples.question: Name 3 persons who acted in the most movies with a tagline containing 'journey'.

examples.question: Which 3 persons have the most distinct roles in the ACTED_IN relationship?
examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(DISTINCT r.roles) AS distinctRoles ORDER BY distinctRoles DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name, distinctRoles

examples.question: What is the longest movie title in the database?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, size(m.title) AS length ORDER BY length DESC LIMIT 1

examples.question: Which person directed the movie "V for Vendetta"?

examples.question: List the top 3 directors who have directed movies with the highest average votes.
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH m, avg(m.votes) AS average_votes MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m) WITH p, average_votes ORDER BY average_votes DESC RETURN p.name AS director_name, avg(average_votes) AS average_movie_votes LIMIT 3

examples.question: What are the first 3 movies with a vote count less than 100?
examples.cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.votes < 100 RETURN m.title ORDER BY m.votes LIMIT 3

examples.cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Keanu Reeves'})-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, collect(r.roles) AS rolesList UNWIND rolesList AS roles UNWIND roles AS role RETURN p.name, role, count(*) AS times_played ORDER BY times_played DESC
